notes.title: Engine update
notes.notes:
[h2]-Change Log-[/h2]
The update fixes all reported bugs and crashes. The game was stuck in a very old, unsupported version of the Monogame engine, and by porting it, I can now support the game again.

[list]
[*] Updated the engine to the latest Monogame version.
[*] Updated to .NET 8.
[*] Removed online multiplayer and fixed the join crash issue.
[*] Removed Steam controller support.
[*] Removed PlayStation controller mapping.
[*] Old saves are reset (does not change much)
[/list]

[h2]Try out my latest game[/h2]
A real-time grand strategy game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1223150/DSS_war_party/

notes.title: Changed engine
notes.notes:
Converted to MONOGAME/OpenGL (from XNA/DirectX)
Locked to 64bit OS (wont work on win xp/vista anymore)
Removed ability to join with controller sticks/Dpad
Removed native Steam controller support (not worth all the extra work)
Added multi screen support

There has been a lot of hassle with getting the controllers work, if you get any issues - print screen the input Debug screen (see options) and post it.

notes.title: Rebranding Party Jousting
notes.notes:
I am rebranding the DLC from being a donation - to unlock 5 extra game modes for 5$.

-Zombie DLC has already been removed.
-Hat DLC will cost 5$, and unlocks all game modes.
-Bling DLC will cost 30$, and is only there for those who want to unlock all Steam trading cards (Not worth it, but those are Steams rules not mine).

This prices will change in about a week.

The five extra game modes (plus cards) will be released around Jan 2019, after the Xbox ONE release.

notes.title: Closed beta test: Strategy game mode
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZQwscc4.jpg[/img]
Updated the game with a test of a Risk style game mode. It is only a "proof of concept"-test and very ugly and bare boned. My playtesters thought it was very addicting - and now I am interested in your opinion!

-Only available for Bling DLC owners-

[b]How the game works[/b]
-The goal is to collect 30 stars (the game does not end on its own)
-The gray squares (castles) can buy more soldiers for 2coins each.
-You get a multiplier bonus if you got 2, 3 or 5 times the soldiers, during battle.
-Esc will exit to lobby, Back will reset (there is no pause)
-Tip is to hit Back a few times until the map looks good.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Launch report - first month of sales
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eohvl6U.jpg[/img]

During my first month I've got about 60 000 downloads. I am not allowed to reveal sales numbers, but I can say that less than 1% of users buy DLC. The income doesn't even cover the food I eat while working on the updates. So in short the game is a failure.

I will still keep updating for a bit more, at least as long I think the game is fun to work on. The biggest drawback so far has been freeloaders who try to bully me into giving them the stuff they want (often free characters or online mode).

I am very grateful for the players who bought DLC, thank you! And since launch there has been about four new videos every day from Lets Players, which have been fun to watch!

notes.title: Online Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Ive changed my mind about this. But I plan to make it a separate mode that is more fitting for online play, this should allow for up to 100 players in a match, each computer can have up to 16 players.

Having a free game with multiplayer makes it a heaven for trolls and cheaters, will probably need to have some 1$ cost to be able to play publicly, otherwise its free with friends only.
-Please comment if you think this extra cost is reasonable.

I will do a beta testing to see if it is fun, if people don't get hooked I will terminate the multiplayer project.

notes.title: Release notes
notes.notes:
Party Jousting started as a joke in spring-2014, and quickly became very popular among my friends. The original game was developed in five days. The original art and characters where all made with my iPad, on a boring bus-trip.
I released it on Xbox360, under the game "Failing Bird". It reached number one top selling in Europe, and has been my most 'income gained/time spent' game.

The game has always been a huge success on game conventions, and each time people tell me it is the most fun they ever had with a game (there is a lot of other games that are more fun than mine, I have no delusions about that).

I hope you enjoy it too!

//Fabian Viking

I released it on Xbox360, under the game "Failing Bird". It reached number one top selling in Europe, and has been my most 'income gained/time spent' game.

The game has always been a huge success on game conventions, and each time people tell me it is the most fun they ever had with a game (there is a lot of other games that are more fun than mine, I have no delusions about that).

I hope you enjoy it too!

//Fabian Viking
